text: {"translations": {"fr": "Je suis si fière de toi mon garçon, tu es devenu un vrai homme !", "es": "¡Que Dios te bendiga mi niño, te has convertido en todo un hombre!", "it": "Che Dio ti benedica ragazzo mio, sei diventato un vero uomo!", "en": "Look at you, my boy, I'm so proud of you, you've grown into a real man!"}, "feeling": ["pride", "love", "blessing"], "cultural_notes": [{"expression": "tbarkallah 3lik", "literal": "God's blessing is upon you", "meaning": "Said to express pride and admiration, while also invoking God's blessing to ward off envy."}], "confidence": "high"}
